cubes.name: events
cubes.title: Events
cubes.description: Product events with fields from the JSON payload
cubes.sql:
`SELECT
  e.EVENT_ID,
  e.EVENT_NAME,
  e.EVENT_TS,
  e.PAYLOAD:device::STRING AS PAYLOAD_DEVICE,
  e.PAYLOAD:plan::STRING AS PAYLOAD_PLAN,
  e.PAYLOAD:amount::NUMBER(10,2) AS AMOUNT
FROM DWH_TESTING.PIPELINES.EVENTS_RAW AS e WHERE ${FILTER_GROUP(FILTER_PARAMS.events.event_at.filter("e.EVENT_TS"), FILTER_PARAMS.events.name.filter("e.EVENT_NAME"))}
`

cubes.name: calendar
cubes.title: Fiscal calendar
cubes.description: One row for each day. The fiscal year starts on 1 February.
cubes.sql:
`SELECT
  d.CALENDAR_DATE,
  DATE_TRUNC('month', d.CALENDAR_DATE) AS MONTH_START,
  DATEADD('month', 1, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', DATEADD('month', -1, d.CALENDAR_DATE))) AS FISCAL_QUARTER_START,
  DATEADD('month', 1, DATE_TRUNC('year', DATEADD('month', -1, d.CALENDAR_DATE))) AS FISCAL_YEAR_START,
  YEAR(DATEADD('month', -1, d.CALENDAR_DATE)) AS FISCAL_YEAR,
  DATEADD('year', -1, d.CALENDAR_DATE) AS PRIOR_FISCAL_YEAR_DATE,
  DATEADD('month', -1, d.CALENDAR_DATE) AS PRIOR_MONTH_DATE,
  DAYNAME(d.CALENDAR_DATE) AS DAY_NAME,
  DAYOFWEEKISO(d.CALENDAR_DATE) >= 6 AS IS_WEEKEND
FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD('day', ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4()) - 1, '2024-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS CALENDAR_DATE
  FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 1461))
) AS d
`

dimensions.name: customers.lifetime_tier
dimensions.title: Customers Lifetime Tier
dimensions.sql:
`CASE
  WHEN ${lifetime_revenue} >= 30000 THEN 'high'
  WHEN ${lifetime_revenue} >= 10000 THEN 'medium'
  ELSE 'low'
END
`

cubes.sql:
`SELECT
  c.ID,
  c.EMAIL,
  c.FULL_NAME,
  c.REGION,
  CASE c.REGION WHEN 'US' THEN 39.8 WHEN 'EU' THEN 50.1 WHEN 'APAC' THEN 1.35 WHEN 'LATAM' THEN -15.8 END AS REGION_LAT,
  CASE c.REGION WHEN 'US' THEN -98.6 WHEN 'EU' THEN 9.7 WHEN 'APAC' THEN 103.8 WHEN 'LATAM' THEN -47.9 END AS REGION_LON
FROM DWH_TESTING.SCHEMA_B.CUSTOMERS AS c
`
